# As-built design summary (generated by tools/report_design.py; do not edit)

Project silkscreen-light-attachment rev B, 2026-09-25. Frames: KiCad K (x_K = X + 100, y_K = 100 - Z) and enclosure E (X, Z; Y up the device). All parts on F.Cu (faces -Y, toward the case).

Board outline bbox (K): x 97.475..162.525, y 88.975..106.025; thickness 1.000 mm; 2 copper layers.

## String voltage sanity

- N = 5 LEDs per string, Rs = 200 R (CRCW0805200RFKEAHP), no series diode (rev B).
- N x Vf at 13.3 mA: 13.00 / 14.25 / 15.75 V (min / typ / max, 25 C); 16.27 V max at -10 C.
- Rs drop 2.66 V at 13.3 mA (2.79 V at 13.96 mA); Rs dissipation 39 mW.
- LED_SW (V_OUT, incl. R37 sense + FET; no diode): 16.01 V min hot, 17.26 V typ, **19.41 V worst (cold, max bin)** vs the 22.0 V ceiling (margin 2.59 V) and OVP min 24.25 V (margin 4.84 V).
- Hold-off at ~14 uA hot: 11.5 V > 6.5 V (boost body-diode rule).
- LED_MONIT lit 1.71..2.08 V; open 2.60..2.73 V (separated).
- Hot-plug peak (C9 at OVP, loop 243.5 R incl. Rs 200 R; typ..min LED bin): TPS923610 (25.5 V) 47.0-52.6 mA, TPS923611 (31.4 V) 71.3-76.8 mA, both < IFP 80 mA (IFP is rated at 0.1 ms, 1/10 duty; this pulse lasts ~0.25-1 ms, so the margin is an estimate) (gate). TPS923611 LED_SW-to-GND misinsertion ~83 mA until the OVP latch. Rs peak power in the worst pulse 1.18 W for ~1 ms (pulse-proof CRCW-HP 0805).
- Verdict: PASS.

## Parts and sourcing

- Rs choice: CRCW0805200RFKEAHP (LCSC C5972814, JLC Extended): pulse-proof 0805, kept from rev A; no JLC Basic 200 R with a documented ~1 W / 1 ms pulse rating was substituted (checked 2026-09-25 (JLC parts API, JLC Extended)). DigiKey 541-CRCW0805200RFKEAHPCT-ND (DigiKey search page for the MPN, 2026-09-25).
- J1 Hong Cheng HC-PZ254-11.5L-1x2PZ (LCSC C27985187, JLC Extended (no Basic 2.54 mm headers are listed; checked 2026-09-25); stock 24852 on 2026-09-25), pads J6 5/6: **hand-soldered by the builder**, in bom.csv, not in jlc_bom.csv / jlc_cpl.csv (12 SMT parts). DigiKey alternative: Harwin M20-9990246 (DigiKey product 3728226) - 6.1 mm post.
- J2 Hong Cheng HC-PZ254-11.5L-1x1PZ (LCSC C27985186, JLC Extended (no Basic 2.54 mm headers are listed; checked 2026-09-25); stock 10775 on 2026-09-25), pads J6 11: **hand-soldered by the builder**, in bom.csv, not in jlc_bom.csv / jlc_cpl.csv (12 SMT parts). DigiKey alternative: 1 pin cut from Harwin M20-9990246 (DigiKey product 3728226).
- Header numbers: body 2.5 / post 6.0 / tail 3.0 / pin 0.64 sq. Source: LCSC/JLC product attributes 2026-09-25 (insulation height 2.5 mm, mating pin 6 mm, end pin 3 mm, square pin, brass, gold); total 11.5 mm from the MPN; 0.64 mm square pin assumed (not listed). Alternative: Harwin M20-9990246 (DigiKey product 3728226): 1x2, 3 mm tail, 6.1 mm mating (tin); 0.1 mm deeper.
- Post tips at Y 108.10 (underside 116.60 - body 2.5 - post 6.0); J6 face Y 112.82..113.15 -> engagement 4.72..5.05 mm (limits 3.7..6.0). Tails end at Y 119.60 (2.00 above the PCB top).
- LEDs: MPN shared by every CCT; warm = C210340 (3000 K), cool = C210343 (6000 K). DigiKey: n/a - LCSC only (C210340 warm / C210343 cool).
- CPL rotation offsets (EasyEDA footprints, docs/sources/ee_*.json): LED C210340 +0 (pad 1 at -x in both), R 0805 +0 (non-polar). See docs/jlc-notes.md.

## Deviations / notes (DESIGN-SPEC-revB)

- STEP frame: kicad-cli 9.0.6 writes the bare dielectric slab (0.91) at z_s 0..0.91 and seats F-side models on the component plane z_F (~0.995). make_outputs calibrates z_F on the J1 body box and maps Y = 116.60 - (z_s - z_F), X = x_s - 100, Z = 100 + y_s (+90 deg about X, det +1). Header tips are asserted at the geometry.json values; the slab in the E-frame STEP is ~0.09 thinner than 1.0 (copper + mask not modelled). Use build/geometry.json for fit.
- LED silk cathode mark = two short bars along the long sides over pad 1 (a bar across the end would sit in the 0.43 gap of a warm/cool pair). LED courtyard = pads + 0.195 so the 3.8 mm pair pitch leaves 0.04.
- Header courtyards = the modelled bodies (2.50 wide per row), so J1 and J2 sit 0.04 apart; the F-side silk is one L-shaped outline around both bodies drawn on the board, not in the footprints.
- Part keep-outs (case top except the J6 opening, LED band, R zone, boss holes +0.4) are enforced by tools/check_handedness.py (courtyard boxes), not by KiCad rule areas.
- Header pin section 0.64 square and body width 2.50 are assumed (standard for the HC-PZ254 style; the LCSC page lists body 2.5 / post 6 / tail 3 but no drawing numbers were readable).
- Fab outputs (Gerber X2 dates, STEP, PDFs) carry timestamps; the generated KiCad sources are deterministic.
